==Ingredients==
* 4–5 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] malted chocolate mix or [[w:Ovaltine|Ovaltine]] (Ovomaltine), or dry malt extract
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Chocolate#Cocoa Powder|cocoa powder]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (236 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) hot water

==Procedure==

# Mix the Ovaltine and cocoa powder together. 
# Pound with a spoon until very fine—this will help reduce stirring time.
# Shake the Ovaltine and cocoa powder for 10 seconds.
#Pour the mix into the hot water. Stir well.
#Top with whipped cream if desired and serve, sprinkled with cinnamon or chocolate powder, if desired.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* For a sweeter taste, add 1 tbsp of Hershey's Chocolate Mix to the hot water and stir.

==See also==
*[[Cookbook:Hot Chocolate|Hot Chocolate]]
*[[Cookbook:Hot Chocolate with Cayenne|Hot Chocolate with Cayenne]]
*[[Cookbook:Orange Hot Chocolate|Orange Hot Chocolate]]
